svg.title: Contribution 2 · Background intervention on the Mamba step size
svg.desc: The auxiliary branch changes the background outside ground-truth boxes. Only its step size is used to recompute the original example's state. Original queries, content and geometry are preserved. The hybrid prediction uses final classification, L1 and GIoU supervision with the original targets.

g.text: Contribution 2 · Background intervention on the Mamba step size
Inference: one image supplies both the visual evidence and the step size.
COCO 426166 · Blue Bike by Talbot Troy · CC BY 2.0 · cropped; background color edited in the paired view.
Use the original detection targets for both predictions.
